Open a Trained Model to Fine-Tune From

Source: R/fine_tune.R
resolve.parent.Rd

A fine-tuned model starts from a trained one, its parent: a checkpoint, or a member of a model suite such as the released EVA suites. It reads the vegetation plots exactly as the parent does (the parent's species, genus, family and categorical vocabularies, its loader settings and the scaling of its coordinates and covariates), starts from the parent's encoder, and trains heads for your own targets: a national habitat typology, a soil or management variable, or a released target refitted on regional plots.

Usage

resolve.parent(source, target = NULL, seed = NULL)

Arguments

source

Path of a checkpoint, or of a suite directory (one holding manifest.json).

target

For a suite: the target whose member to start from. May be left NULL for a suite of one target.

seed

For a suite: the member's seed (NULL, the default, takes the target's first member).

Value

A Parent object (an Rcpp module class): vocabs() and dataset_config() are what the fine-tuning dataset is loaded with, model_config() the configuration the fine-tuned model takes, schema() and scalers() the parent's, and record() the record a fine-tuned checkpoint keeps of it (path, SHA-256, size, engine version, and the suite, target and seed it came from). A suite member's size and SHA-256 are checked against the manifest before it is read.

Details

Load the fine-tuning plots with the parent's vocabularies and loader settings, then pass the parent to resolve.train.dataset() as initFrom:

parent <- resolve.parent(suite_dir, target = "habitat")
dataset <- resolve.dataset.csv(header, species, roles, targets,
                               vocabs = parent$vocabs(),
                               config = parent$dataset_config())
fit <- resolve.train.dataset(dataset, initFrom = parent, freezeEncoder = TRUE)

Examples

source(system.file("examples", "habitat-suite.R", package = "resolveR"))
resolve.seal_suite(suite_dir)
parent <- resolve.parent(suite_dir, target = "habitat", seed = 1L)
parent$record()$suite_target
